# Local SQLite browser runtime

Unmodified sql.js 1.14.2 files dist/sql-wasm.js, dist/sql-wasm.wasm and LICENSE,
copied from the exact package pinned in ../../package-lock.json. MIT license
included. No CDN or network storage is used at runtime.

Refresh from the same pin with npm ci --ignore-scripts, then copy these three
files from node_modules/sql.js. API: https://sql.js.org/documentation/.
